description: This file defines a template class 'TokenizedStringList' that provides functionality for tokenizing strings based on a separator character, optionally removing whitespace, and managing the list of tokens.

classes.name: TokenizedStringList
classes.description: A template class that tokenizes strings based on a specified separator character and provides methods to access and manipulate the list of tokens.

methods.name: Tokenize
methods.description: Splits the input string into tokens based on the separator, optionally removing whitespace.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all tokens from the list.

methods.name: First
methods.description: Returns the first token in the list.

methods.name: All
methods.description: Concatenates all tokens into a single string separated by the separator.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Checks if the token list is empty.
